title: Uncovering Biases with Reflective Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing bias ratings generated through structured adversarial LLM dialogues against ground-truth labels from human annotators with declared political affiliations (Democrats and Republicans) on a dataset of news articles covering political scandals.

Evaluating and mitigating bias in historical narratives by using multi-agent LLM dialogues conditioned on opposing cultural and historical perspectives (e.g., Euro-centric vs. Indigenous viewpoints on Christopher Columbus).
